fields.statement: At 601a755d, go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(request-ref-risk-note|describe-golden)$' -count=1 -v: both PASS. The script sets rhiza.autonomy.plan auto and rhiza.daemon.permissionMode bypassPermissions, runs request --ref, sees 'Queued feature request', exactly one '^Note: .*workflow plan' line saying 'no permission checks', request ls lists the request, and --json carries a note naming plan; a request without --ref and one with plan owner print no Note. describe-golden passes with the new note field. Read the diff: runRequest still queues as before and only adds requestRiskNote, which returns empty for no ref, unreadable settings or an empty requestExposedWorkflows list.
